title.narrative: Strengthening coastal governance and ecosystem res

description.narrative:
For 2025, IUCN intends to implement regenerative blue economy models in Inhambane Province over three years, generating sustainable livelihoods and youth employment, while restoring coastal ecosystems and strengthening provincial and community-led governance for climate resilience and biodiversity conservation, the CORE RESTOR phase 2. - IUCN goal for this project is to implement regenerative blue economy models in Inhambane Province, generating sustainable livelihoods and youth employment, while restoring coastal ecosystems and strengthening provincial and community-led governance for climate resilience and biodiversity conservation. IUCN main interventions for 2025 grant are:
• Technical assistance: Continue to support the Provincial Government, particularly DPAPI, in planning, budgeting and monitoring, as well as capacity building on inclusivity in coastal and marine conservation, reporting, planning and blue business, and nature-based solutions (NbS). • Consolidating and expanding ecological restoration: Unlock critical habitats in communities affect ecosystem services, including nature-based solutions to strengthen climate resilience and mitigate the impact of climate change, such as coastal erosion. • Supporting the development of a blue economy: Promote blue business and create jobs for young people and women to demonstrate the economic value of the coastal and marine environment to coastal communities and meaningfully build climate resilience. • Inhambane City as a sustainable city, providing a foundation for future urban nature-based solutions interventions.
